afterFileEdit.description: Auto-format with Prettier for .js/.mjs/.cjs/.css (only when a .prettierrc and a local prettier binary exist; this repo has neither, so it is a no-op).

Security-lint changed files for injection/auth/CSRF patterns. NOTE: under Cursor afterFileEdit (observe-only) the findings JSON goes to logs only — the agent does NOT see it; real enforcement is Claude-side.
Propagation nudge when .ai/docs/* is edited. NOTE: logs-only under Cursor afterFileEdit — the agent does NOT see it; the workflow.mdc Phase 7 checklist is the Cursor-side enforcement.
Flag post-write edits to .env/credentials/lock files/.git (Cursor has no before-edit block event; afterFileEdit is the earliest available).

beforeShellExecution.description: Block rm -rf, git push --force, DROP DATABASE, etc. Shares the rule set of .claude/hooks/block-destructive.js (Cursor-native payload + permission:deny).
Ask before render/approve/sequence commands run (mirrors the Claude seat disallowedTools and Copilot autoApprove gate).

beforeReadFile.description: Deny reading .env/credentials/keys into the LLM (lock files: reads allowed, edits flagged). Other files are allowed as-is — Cursor beforeReadFile cannot rewrite content, so no post-read redaction is possible; secrets in source are handled by the deny matchers + .gitignore policy.

stop.description: Log checkpoint marker (timestamp + changed file count) when agent completes. Does not create git stash.
